artifacts.caption: Parameter-specific recovery across 16 four-observation sampling designs in the controlled synthetic 1-D transport benchmark. Each design-parameter cell contains 250 paired replicates; uncertainty bounds are 2.5th and 97.5th percentiles from 2,000 bootstrap resamples.
artifacts.technical_description: Production TransportCalibrationAdapter and PESTGLM calculations using log10-transformed parameters, no start-centred prior residuals, and observation-error-whitened sensitivities. Condition numbers refer to the local log-parameter Fisher matrix.
artifacts.interpretation: Sampling placement affected the parameters differently: the lowest median error occurred for c90_s45 for dispersivity and very_late for decay. The corrected rank-correlation analysis did not reproduce the earlier opposed-sign conditioning result.

artifacts.caption: Realised parameter recovery after adding one observation to a three-point late-time transport design. Results are separated by local and distant initialisation and parameter; each strategy contains 250 paired replicates. The random strategy varied candidate time across replicates.
artifacts.technical_description: Candidate times were scored using parameter marginal variance, D-, A-, E- and balanced criteria in the whitened log-parameter Fisher matrix. Common noise and starting values enabled paired comparisons.
artifacts.interpretation: Every local criterion selected 50 d, so the prespecified different-target optimum was not confirmed. Relative to no new measurement, the common 50 d observation reduced median dispersivity absolute log10 error from 0.2154 to 0.0173 and decay error from 0.0182 to 0.0146 under local starts.

artifacts.caption: Local information rank for calcite rate constant k and reactive surface area A in the production PHREEQC kinetic adapter, using one time, four times, and four times plus an independent surface-area observation.
artifacts.technical_description: Central finite differences were taken with respect to log10(k) and log10(A). Concentration sensitivities were whitened by 0.005 mmol L^-1; the external surface-area observation had a standard deviation of 0.10 log10 units.
artifacts.interpretation: Additional residence times did not separate k from A because the rate law depends on their product. Independent surface-area evidence increased the local information rank from one to two.

artifacts.caption: Confirmatory controlled-synthetic M8 benchmark. (A) Median parameter-specific recovery across fixed transport designs versus the condition number of the whitened log-parameter Fisher matrix. (B) Predicted marginal uncertainty for a candidate observation added to a late-time base; every local criterion selected 50 d. (C) Realised median errors for the common optimum, varied random choice, redundant late observation and no new observation under paired local starts. (D) The production PHREEQC kinetic data identify k*A with rank one; an independent surface-area observation restores rank two.
artifacts.technical_description: Balanced 2x2, 3600 by 2700 pixel PNG with a vector PDF companion. Generated by scripts/make_m8_reviewed_artifacts.py from RUN-M8-CONFIRM-20260728-01 registered tables.
artifacts.interpretation: The anticipated split between parameter-targeted next observations was not reproduced. Measurement placement still mattered strongly for transport recovery, while the kinetic case established a structural limit that sampling time alone cannot repair.
